name: amazon-transaction-mcp
description: Use a private Amazon account's orders, item prices, shipments, and payment transactions through a read-only MCP workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Read private Amazon orders and transactions
interface.longDescription: Connect to the private Amazon Transaction MCP and follow its timeout-safe workflows for order history, item prices, transactions, login recovery, and MFA.
defaultPrompt: Get last week's Amazon orders and each item's price.
Find my recent Amazon purchases matching a product name.
List recent Amazon charges and refunds.
